commits.author: karansag
commits.message:
[evaldash] Add sort direction and last-updated column (#9104)

Panel headers sort in both directions. Benchmark columns rank by
interval lower bound, and missing values stay at the bottom. Model names
default to ascending order; coverage, benchmark, and timestamp columns
default to descending order.

The panel response includes `last_updated`, the maximum `created_at`
among the cells included in each row. The table displays it, and cell
tooltips show each result's timestamp.

Fixes #8145
Fixes #8142

commits.author: rjpower
commits.message:
[iris] Bound federation heartbeats per peer (#9134)

Give each federation peer an independent capability-heartbeat loop and
cap
`ListBackends` at 10 seconds. On September 12, a half-open US-EAST-02A
request
held Marin's shared heartbeat loop for 32 hours. This prevented fresh
`ListPeers` observations, kept every peer reachable with stale
availability,
and stopped queued H100 jobs from promotion.

Per-peer sync loops continued mirroring jobs and are unchanged. On a
timeout,
`FederationPeer.probe` retains the peer's last-known backends for
reporting,
marks the peer unreachable, and excludes it from scheduling.

Incident: https://echo.oa.dev/wiki/422

Fixes #9133
